_comments: Variant c: gpt-5.4-mini with reasoningEffort 'none' (no hidden reasoning tokens, so time to first token stays low). Newest small OpenAI model in Vapi's enum; newer small models are generally stronger at tool calling than gpt-4.1-mini, but Vapi doesn't publish tool-reliability or latency numbers per model, so this is a measured experiment, not a known win. temperature is removed (GPT-5 models may reject a non-default temperature). 24h prompt cache is supported (spec list).
